description: Named at home, and not in the porch.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Priced the loaf, named the sword, and barred a story fit for strangers.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Named on the settle, and not moved.
name: Gib

description: Went out behind the sword and did not speak.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Ended the morning and did not ask Sir John for a word.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: Refused the supper-story and the argument about the loaf.
name: William Shakespeare
